description: EveryInfra provides APIs for social, review, e-commerce, job, search, CAPTCHA-solving, and OpenAI-compatible AI tasks behind a shared prepaid account. It aggregates many platform-specific data capabilities into unified endpoints and also offers a remote MCP server for AI clients.
summary: EveryInfra exposes a REST API at `https://api.everyinfra.com` secured by a bearer API key, plus remote MCP endpoints at `https://api.everyinfra.com/mcp` and `https://everyinfra.com/mcp`; the docs also identify several public no-key catalog/discovery endpoints within the REST API.
